events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (/app/index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

events.content:
Created the single-file interactive hero page at [index.html](file:///app/index.html) with inline CSS, SVG, and JavaScript and zero external assets or embedded raster artwork.

### What Was Built
- **Pure Atmospheric Composition ([index.html](file:///app/index.html))**:
  - A dark, moody yakisugi tabletop backdrop rendered on `#bg-canvas` with warm ambient key lighting, subtle lantern-breathing glow (`.ambient-glow`), drifting golden dust motes, and a soft vignette.
  - No UI controls, text overlays, or menus—keeping the steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus.
- **Handcrafted Vector Vegan Ramen (`#ramen-svg`)**:
  - **Ceramic Bowl**: Kuro-Tenmoku dark iron-glazed stoneware with wheel-thrown ridges, warm terracotta rim break, ceramic foot (`kodai`), and dynamic specular rim catchlights.
  - **Broth & Noodles**: Rich miso-sesame broth with black garlic oil (`mayu`) and chili oil (`rayu`) swirls, glistening folded alkaline noodles, and 48 procedurally placed golden/chili oil pearls (`#oil-pearls`).
  - **Vegan Toppings**: Blanched halved baby bok choy, braised bamboo shoots (`menma`), star-scored roasted shiitake and diamond-charred king oyster mushroom (`eringi`), seared & tare-glazed vegan tofu chashu slices, charred sweet corn kernels, toasted nori sheets, fresh scallion rings (`negi`), toasted black & white sesame seeds, and curling chili threads (`ito-togarashi`).
- **Motion, Steam & Mouse Interactivity**:
  - **Volumetric Rising Steam (`#steam-canvas`)**: Soft multi-layered steam puffs curling upward from the hot broth, cooling from warm amber-peach near the surface into misty ivory. Moving the cursor through the steam creates an air-current wake that gently parts and carries the vapor.
  - **Broth & Topping Physics**: Hovering or clicking/tapping on the broth spawns expanding surface ripples (`spawnRipple`), parts nearby oil pearls, gently bobs the floating toppings, and shifts layered 3D parallax and ceramic rim highlights (`tick`).
  - **Responsive & Accessible**: Scales cleanly across desktop (`1440×900`) and mobile portrait (`390×844`) viewports while preserving headroom for rising steam, and honors `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` both in CSS and JavaScript (`renderReducedFrame`).

### Verification
- Checked [index.html](file:///app/index.html) for external asset references or embedded raster data (`data:image/`): none present (only standard `http://www.w3.org/2000/svg` XML namespaces).
- Captured and visually inspected headless Chromium screenshots at desktop (`1440×900`) and mobile (`390×844`) viewports to verify framing, steam visibility, lighting, and responsiveness.
